name: Pişti
description: Pişti (pronounced 'Pish-tee') is one of the most beloved card games in Turkey. It is a fishing game where players capture cards from a central pile by matching ranks or playing a Jack (which captures any pile). The name means 'cooked' and refers to the pişti bonus: capturing a single card with a matching rank scores 10 extra points. Fast-paced, with observation and memory.

overview.description: Pişti (pronounced 'Pish-tee') is one of the most beloved card games in Turkey. It is a fishing game where players capture cards from a central pile by matching ranks or playing a Jack (which captures any pile). The name means 'cooked' and refers to the pişti bonus: capturing a single card with a matching rank scores 10 extra points. Fast-paced, with observation and memory.

history.origins: Derived from ancient Central Asian card games and formalized in Turkey during the Ottoman era. It shares roots with the Spanish game 'Escoba'.
timeline: 1900s: Becomes a staple in Turkish tea houses (Kahvehane).
1960s: Standard rules (151-point target) are established in social clubs.
1990s: First digital versions appear in early Turkish PC gaming.
Present: The most common game played during family gatherings (Bayram) and in digital cafes.
history.cultural: In Turkey, scoring a Pişti is often accompanied by the player slapping the card down with a loud bang to celebrate 'Cooking' the opponent.
history.evolution: The'Double Pişti' rule (capturing a Jack with a Jack) was added to increase the volatility and excitement of the endgame.

setup.players: 2 players (this variant). Also commonly 4 in partnerships or 4 individuals; rules are the same.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack (French suits, no jokers). Pişti uses the full deck: four cards are dealt face down to the centre, four to each player, and the remainder forms the stock; one centre card is turned face up to start the pile.
setup.dealing: Dealer shuffles; player to dealer's left cuts. Dealer deals 4 cards face down to the center, then 4 to each player. Remaining cards form the stock. One of the four center cards is turned face up to start the pile (if it is a Jack, turn until a non-Jack). Player to dealer's right plays first. After all play their 4 cards, dealer deals 4 more to each from stock; repeat until stock is exhausted.

rules.objective: Be the first to reach 151 points (or first team in partnership play). If both reach 151 on the same hand, the higher score wins.
rules.gameplay: Each turn, play one card from your hand face up onto the center pile. If your card's rank matches the top card of the pile, you capture the whole pile; playing a Jack also captures the pile regardless of the top card. Otherwise your card stays on the pile. The first capture also takes the four face-down center cards. When everyone has played their four cards, the dealer deals four more to each from the stock; play continues until the stock is exhausted. The last team or player to make a capture takes any remaining cards. Score after each hand; first to 151 wins.
keyRules: Match the rank of the top card to capture the pile, or play a Jack to capture any pile.
First capture also takes the four face-down center cards.
Pişti: capturing a single card with a matching rank (not Jack) scores 10 bonus points; Jack on single Jack is double pişti (20 points). No pişti on the very first or very last card of the hand.
Points: Jack 1, Ace 1, 2 of Clubs 2, 10 of Diamonds 3, majority of cards 3, each pişti 10 (double pişti 20).

strategy.basic: Keep track of the Jacks! Since the Jack is a wild capture, don't drop a high-point card (like the 10 of Diamonds) into the center if your opponent hasn't played their Jacks yet. If you have the same rank as the top card, play it immediatelyâ€”don't 'Save' it, because the opponent might play a Jack and steal your match.
strategy.intermediate: The 'Pişti' Setup: If you are the first player and the center card is something you have in your hand (e.g., an 8 is showing and you have an 8), play it. If the next person doesn't have an 8 or a Jack, you have a high chance of scoring a Pişti on your next turn. Memory is key: remember which ranks have been 'Clear' so you don't drop a card that can be 'Pish-teed'.
strategy.advanced: The 'Endgame Vacuum': The winner of the very last trick gets all remaining cards in the center. In the final round of dealing, save your Jacks for the final two cards. This ensures that even if you didn't match anything mid-round, you can 'Sweep' the table for the 'Most Cards' bonus, which is often the tie-breaker for the 151 goal.
tips: The 10 of Diamonds (3 pts) and 2 of Clubs (2 pts) are the 'Gold' cards. Protect them!
If you suspect your opponent has a Jack, lead a 'Low' card (like a 4 or 5) to lure their Jack out on a useless pile.

variations.name: Four in partnerships
variations.description: Four players in two partnerships, partners sitting opposite. Rules same; play anticlockwise. First team to 151 wins.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation uses same engine constants; no overrides needed.

variations.name: Four individuals
variations.description: Four players each keeping individual score. Same rules; first to 151 wins.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variation uses same engine constants; no overrides needed.

variations.name: Bluffing variation
variations.description: When one card is on the table, next player may play a card face down claiming a pişti. If the first player believes it, 10 points; if not and it was a bluff, first player scores 20; if not and it matched, double pişti 20 to the captor.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Bluffing variant; engine overrides not yet specified.

scoring.description: Points for captured cards: Jack 1, Ace 1, 2 of Clubs 2, 10 of Diamonds 3; majority of cards 3; pişti (single-card capture by matching rank) 10; double pişti (Jack on Jack) 20. If both take 26 cards, no majority point. First to 151 wins.
scoring.winCondition: First to reach 151 or more points at the end of a hand; if both reach 151 on the same hand, the higher score wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Pişti (pronounced 'Pish-tee') is a Turkish fishing game: capture the center pile by matching rank or playing a Jack; first to 151 points wins.
